title: Wren and the Crown
author: Isandro Dunmore
blurb: Jude Hartwell, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
